transcripts: W: What do bees do for plants?  M: They carry pollen from flower to flower.
M: Why should we protect pandas?  W: Because they are in danger.
W: What is a big problem for animals?  M: Climate change. It changes the weather.
M: Do small insects matter?  W: Yes, they play an important role in the ecosystem.
W: What happens if bees disappear?  M: We will have fewer flowers and fruits.
W: Look at the bees on the flowers.  M: They are working hard.  W: What do they do?  M: They carry pollen from flower to flower. This is pollination. Because of it, plants can make seeds.
M: Why are pandas in danger?  W: Because they lose their homes.  M: What can we do?  W: We can protect the bamboo forest.  M: That's a good idea.  W: If we protect them, pandas will have a good life.
W: The weather is getting warmer.  M: Yes, climate change is a big problem.  W: How does it affect animals?  M: Some animals cannot find food. So we must protect the environment.

M: A forest is a big ecosystem.  W: What lives there?  M: Trees, animals and insects. They are connected with each other.  W: How?  M: Birds eat insects and spread seeds. So trees can grow.  W: That's amazing.

W: Do you know about sea animals?  M: Yes, they live in the ocean.  W: Why should we protect them?  M: Because they play an important role in the sea ecosystem.  W: What can we do?  M: We can keep the ocean clean.

Hello, everyone. This morning I went to the park for nature observation. I saw bees carrying pollen on the flowers. A mother bird was feeding her babies. I noticed that the trees and the insects are connected. Because the insects help the trees, the forest stays healthy. I learned that every living thing is important. If we protect nature, our planet will be a wonderful home.

reading_a.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 花园里的早晨
paragraphs: On a sunny morning, I go to the garden to watch the bees. I want to see how they help plants. A bee flies to a flower and lands on it. It carries pollen from that flower to another one. This is called pollination. Because of this, plants can make seeds and grow.

I imagine a world without bees. There would be no flowers or fruits. The bees are connected with the plants in the garden. They play an important role in the ecosystem. A butterfly also flies by and helps with pollination.

I learn that even small insects are important. Because bees work so hard, our garden is full of life. If we do not protect them, many plants may disappear. Now I understand the importance of every living thing. I will always remember this morning in the garden. I look at the garden and see the flowers opening. The bees move from one flower to the next. They never stop working. This small garden is a busy place. The garden is a good place to learn about nature. I watch the bees and the flowers every day.

How to keep the garden clean.

reading_b.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 地球上共同生活
paragraphs: All living things on Earth are connected with each other. Plants and animals depend on one another. For example, bees help plants by carrying pollen. Because of this, plants can grow and give us food. Animals play an important role in the ecosystem too.

Birds eat insects and spread seeds. Some animals keep the balance of nature. The importance of this connection is clear. If one kind of animal disappears, other animals may be in danger. We must protect the ecosystem to keep everything in balance.

Climate change is a big problem for plants and animals. Because the weather is changing, some animals cannot find food. So we should work together to protect our natural world. We can plant trees, save water and reduce waste. If we all do our part, the earth will be a healthy home for everyone. Remember, every small action is connected with the future of our planet. Nature is a team. Every plant and animal has a job. If we hurt one part, the whole team may break. So we must be careful with our actions. We share the earth with many living things. Every one of them is connected with us. Protecting nature means protecting ourselves.

questions.q: How do bees help plants?
Why is climate change a problem?
What does the word "balance" mean in the passage?
opts: A state where things are equal.

questions.q: What is the passage mainly about?
opts: How plants and animals are connected.

reading_c.provenance: 教师授权原创（2026-08-08）· 动植物的重要性
paragraphs: Why are plants and animals important? The answer is simple: we need them every day. Plants and animals are connected with our lives in many ways. First, plants give us food and clean air. We eat vegetables and fruits, and trees give us oxygen. Because plants make oxygen, we can breathe.

Animals also give us food, such as meat, milk and eggs. Second, animals help plants grow. Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, so plants can make seeds. This is pollination, and it plays an important role in our food supply. If we imagine a world without bees, we would have fewer fruits and vegetables. So we must protect them.

Third, a healthy ecosystem keeps the earth in balance. Forests, animals and insects all work together. Climate change can break this balance, because it changes the weather. So we should protect the environment. If we all do our part, our planet will stay beautiful for a long time. Remember the importance of every plant and animal. Plants and animals are not only food for us. They are our partners on Earth. We share the same sky and the same land. If we take care of them, they will take care of us. Nature gives us food, air and beauty. We should thank it and protect it. A healthy planet means a happy life for everyone.

questions.q: What do plants give us?
Why should we protect bees?
What is the passage mainly about?
opts: Why plants and animals are important.

sa.title: 阅读短文，回答下列问题或按要求完成句子
paragraphs: Bees are very important to plants. They carry pollen from flower to flower, so plants can make seeds. Because of bees, we have many fruits and vegetables. If bees disappear, there will be fewer flowers and less food. So we must protect bees and their homes. Every small insect plays an important role in the ecosystem.

What will happen if bees disappear?

writing.title: 书面表达（15 分）
writing.prompt: 请用英语写一段说明文，回答 “Why are plants and animals important?”，至少使用 6 个本课目标词。
writing.requirements: 1. 使用本课词汇与句型（because/so/if 因果句、connect、be connected with、play a role in、importance）；2. 至少用 6 个目标词；3. 80 词左右；4. 条理清楚，有主题句和支撑细节。
writing.sample: Plants and animals are very important to us. They are connected with our lives. Plants give us food and clean air. Because plants make oxygen, we can breathe. Animals also give us food, such as milk and eggs. Bees play an important role in the ecosystem. If bees disappear, there will be fewer flowers and fruits. So we must protect them and their homes. Every living thing is important.

grammar_diag.title: 语法诊断（because/so/if 因果句·主旨细节·词义猜测）

questions.q: Bees are important ___ they help plants grow.
Bees carry pollen, ___ plants can grow.
___ we protect bees, plants will grow well.
为了让读者理解段落中心，文章通常会有 ___。
猜词：If bees disappear, they are gone. 句中 disappear 意为 ___。
用所给词的适当形式填空：Bees (help) ___ plants grow.
用所给词的适当形式填空：Plants are (connect) ___ with animals.
用所给词的适当形式填空：We must (protect) ___ the ecosystem.
用所给词的适当形式填空：Bees (carry) ___ pollen from flower to flower.
用所给词的适当形式填空：The (important) ___ of bees is clear.
